name: Altenbeken (Germany)
description: Yellow field with a blue over yellow fly, the yellow hoist part charged with the municipal arms of Altenbeken (a blue viaduct on yellow).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 3 December 1976 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms and a flag, described as blue and yellow striped with the arms in the yellow banner head.

features.role: Altenbeken arms — blue viaduct on yellow
